statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events
The service is to guide anticoagulation management
The diagnosis code G45.9 is associated with the patient
The denial reason code is CO-97
The extended monitoring is clinically necessary to identify the arrhythmic etiology associated with diagnosis code G45.9
